definitions.explanation: A formal, gentle euphemism for death, literally "eternal sleep". Typical of death notices, funeral announcements and condolence letters, usually as {永眠|えいみん}いたしました or {永眠|えいみん}しました.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{永眠|えいみん}⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見守|みまも}られて→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧⟦{安|やす}らか→安らか：12237_yasuraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{永眠|えいみん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My father passed away peacefully, with his family by his side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧{花子|はなこ}{儀|ぎ}、⟦{去|さ}る→去る：02115_saru⟧⟦{十月|じゅうがつ}→十月：00634_juugatsu⟧⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧、{八十八歳|はちじゅうはっさい}⟦にて→〜にて：21803_nite⟧{永眠|えいみん}⟦いたしました→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We announce that our mother, Hanako, passed away on October 2 at the age of eighty-eight.

notes:
Used by the family about their own deceased member, especially in notices; for someone else's death, ⟦{逝去|せいきょ}→逝去：14370_seikyo⟧ or お⟦{亡|な}くなり→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ is more respectful.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{安|やす}らか→安らか：12237_yasuraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{永眠|えいみん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pass away peacefully
- {永眠|えいみん}⟦いたしました→いたす：01314_itasu⟧: has passed away (humble, in notices)
- {永眠|えいみん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち}: final resting place

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{亡|な}くなる→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧: to pass away — the everyday polite word
- ⟦{死去|しきょ}→死去：13240_shikyo⟧: death — neutral, typical of news
- ⟦{逝去|せいきょ}→逝去：14370_seikyo⟧: death — respectful, for someone else's death
